# prism_org_policy_attachment (Resource)

Attaches an AWS Organizations policy to a target (root, organizational unit, or account) through CloudKeeper Prism.

~> **Note:** All attributes of this resource are immutable. Changing any attribute will force the resource to be destroyed and recreated.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Attach a policy to an Organizational Unit
resource "prism_org_policy_attachment" "scp_to_ou" {
  management_account_id = "123456789012"
  policy_id             = prism_org_policy.deny_s3.id
  target_id             = "ou-abc1-exampleou"
}

# Attach a policy to a specific AWS account
resource "prism_org_policy_attachment" "scp_to_account" {
  management_account_id = "123456789012"
  policy_id             = prism_org_policy.deny_s3.id
  target_id             = "987654321098"
}

# Attach a policy to the organization root
resource "prism_org_policy_attachment" "tag_to_root" {
  management_account_id = "123456789012"
  policy_id             = prism_org_policy.require_environment_tag.id
  target_id             = "r-exampleroot"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `management_account_id` (String) The AWS management (payer) account ID that owns the organization. Changing this forces a new resource to be created.
- `policy_id` (String) The unique identifier of the policy to attach. Changing this forces a new resource to be created.
- `target_id` (String) The ID of the root, organizational unit, or account to attach the policy to. Changing this forces a new resource to be created.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The unique identifier for the attachment (format: policy_id/target_id)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Org policy attachments can be imported using management_account_id/policy_id/target_id
terraform import prism_org_policy_attachment.example "123456789012/p-examplepolicyid/ou-abc1-exampleou"
```
